text:
marta_ae: Heads-up — large fintech prospect (NordBank) asking for a POC + 12mo commit. They're asking for a one-time POC credit plus a bespoke discount on the committed monthly spend.
leah_salesops: Can you drop the baseline numbers? commit size, expected qps/throughput, and target unit price they want?
marta_ae: Rough ask from buyer: POC = $30k credit, commit = $75k/mo guaranteed for 12 months. They want ~35% off list on the committed pricing.
raj_se: 35% is steep. Also need to confirm model footprint — are they planning to use embeddings heavy workflows? That impacts instance types.
own_solutions: They mentioned vector search + chat ops, expect bursty embeddings ingestion first 3 months. Probably needs dedicated capacity or private deployment. Could be >2x GPU footprint during ingest.
leah_salesops: Deal desk rules: anything >25% needs deal desk + finance sign-off. >30% needs exec sign-off and must be paired with at least 12mo commit and usage floors.
marta_ae: They're committed to 12mo but want flexibility on overage at lower rate. Also asking for PII processing assurances (security questionnaire in progress).
raj_se: From infra POV: if we guarantee that commit at 75k/mo for shared hosted, we need to reserve slots in EU region for them — capacity planning required. Might be better to offer Dedicated with a lower per-token rate but min committed spend.
leah_salesops: Suggested structure we can present: 1) POC credit = $20k (not $30k), conditional on quick eval completion in 60 days. 2) 12mo commit $75k/mo with tiered discount: 20% off list up to committed usage, 30% off if usage >120% of commit for at least 2 consecutive months. 3) Overage priced at commit-equivalent rate + 10%.
marta_ae: Buyer pushed back — POC is a gating item; they said $30k non-negotiable to get security and eng time. If we reduce POC credit we risk losing momentum.
own_solutions: Can we instead offer the POC as a combination: $20k credit + 10k in services (onboarding/architecture) free? That preserves perceived value and keeps cash exposure lower.
leah_salesops: That could work. Also note: any deal with >25% discount needs a commercial playbook entry and an approved price deviation form. I'll prep the form if we get a confirmed structure.
raj_se: Also flag: private deployment / on-prem will change economics — discounts and commit terms differ. We should confirm whether they actually require VPC/on-prem. If yes, we need security + infra intake and that delays timeline.
marta_ae: I'll push back and propose the compromise (20k credit + 10k services) and the tiered discount structure. Requesting explicit guidance: are we comfortable approving up to 30% if they hit the overage threshold?
leah_salesops: Deal desk initial stance: pre-approval for proposed structure up to 25% off guaranteed commit. For the additional 5% (to reach 30%) we require a conditional clause: customer must hit >120% commit for 2 months and finance must sign off on projected ROI. If legal okays T&Cs, we can escalate to CRO for final sign-off.
dealdesk_bot: automated note: link to rate card v4: https://redwood.internal/rate-cards/v4 — fill the price deviation form: /deals/forms/price-deviation?ts=1801234567 — approvals required: salesops -> finance -> CRO for >25%.
marta_ae: Great, I'll send counter and ask for security questionnaire completion timeline. If buyer accepts, please queue the price-deviation with the draft numbers.
leah_salesops: Please include the justification bullets (strategic fintech anchor, potential multi-region expansion, reference logo) when you submit form. That helps get faster approvals.
raj_se: And include expected infra uplift schedule (month-by-month GPU count estimate) so capacity can reserve nodes.
marta_ae: Will do. Thanks team — pinging again once buyer responds. :pray:
